prompt:
Create exactly ONE transparent cutout of a RACHNI SOLDIER from the ORIGINAL MASS EFFECT 1, accurately based on these actual gameplay screenshots. Match the frontal threat posture and reddish-brown coloration of the single creature in image 1, using image 2 to resolve frontal armor and legs, and image 3 to resolve the pointed leg ends and the creature's body depth. Image 3's dark cyan illumination is scene lighting, not a different skin. This is the ordinary brown Rachni Soldier, not a violet Brood Warrior, not a Queen, not a worker, not an ME3 Ravager. Preserve the distinctive original game's silhouette and low-poly/textured art direction.

Anatomy and materials: broad red-brown layered shell forming a tall shield shape over the thorax, stacked chevron ridges with pale edge rims, small dark head tucked below the shield with segmented gray-blue mouth plates; pale ivory segmented front abdomen; slender dark claw-like mouth appendages; the same angular reddish-brown walking legs with narrow pointed ends as visible in the references. Two long flexible raised lash appendages arc broadly outward and finish in the paired split shell pods shown in reference 1, with gray-white internal surfaces and dark brown exteriors. Preserve the shorter upward hollow shell limbs near the upper body and the thin straight sensory spines crossing in front of the tall shell. Copy their exact attachment points, counts, shapes and proportions from the reference; do not invent extra legs, extra antennae, eyes, mandibles or spikes. Keep a slightly asymmetric alert pose matching the game frame, with both long lash appendages entirely visible. Do not fuse separate limbs together. No weapon, armor additions or redesigned mechanical parts.

Framing: one whole creature, front with only the slight angle in reference 1, entirely visible from every limb/pod tip to the lowest pointed foot. Use a generous landscape canvas; scale the entire creature to occupy at most 75 percent of the image width and 75 percent of its height, leaving at least 12 percent empty padding around the actual silhouette on ALL sides. Copy the true size relationships between shell, pale belly and thin legs; do not make a giant insect torso. Plain neutral lighting so the red-brown shell and pale belly read correctly. Remove all scene elements: no door, wall, blue smoke, mist, glass, lab equipment, floor, people, HUD, shadows or text. Surround the silhouette with fully transparent alpha, crisp clean antialiased edges, no translucent gray haze. The result is one faithful static gameplay creature master, no montage, no variants, no labels.
